title: pvExtractEnclosedPoints
body:
## pvExtractEnclosedPoints

Keeps the input points that lie inside a closed, manifold polygonal Surface (second input) and outputs them as a point cloud (polydata) on port 0; with GenerateOutliers, port 1 holds the points outside. Only points and their point data are kept, not the input's cells. Use it to select particles or probe points within a body; to keep mesh cells, use a clip instead.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- With an open or non-manifold surface the inside/outside test is undefined; enable CheckSurface so the filter first checks that the surface is closed. If that check fails the filter reports "Bad enclosing surface" and stops without producing output (the node fails); it does not mark the points as outside.
- Surface must be a single polygonal surface (not composite); extract the surface of a solid mesh first.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ExtractEnclosedPoints`. Identity: `filters/ExtractEnclosedPoints`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to extract points from. Accepted data: explicit-point datasets (polygonal, unstructured or structured grids) (vtkPointSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPointSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
| `Surface` | Required data input for the native Surface port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the closed and manifold surface. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":false,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CheckSurface` | Specify whether to check the surface for closure. If on, then the algorithm first checks to see if the surface is closed and manifold. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GenerateOutliers` | If checked, then a second output will be created that contains the outlier points. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GenerateVertices` | If checked, then the outputs will contain a poly-vertex cell. This takes a lot more memory, however certain filters many requires cells to be present to function properly. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Tolerance` | Specify the tolerance on the intersection. The tolerance is expressed as a fraction of the diagonal of the bounding box of the enclosing surface. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
